wand_hawthorn.name: Thornbark Rod
wand_hawthorn.desc: Rough thornbark bound with salt-cured cord. It favours patient, steady casting.

wand_ithrel_replica.name: Starcore Rod
wand_ithrel_replica.desc: A bar of shard-iron quenched in Lake Lunra. Loud, unstable and ruinously strong.

wand_ashwood.name: Ashwood Rod
wand_ashwood.desc: Knotted pale ash, its handle bound in hemp twine. Every spell starts with a first rod.

wand_runebound.name: Runebound Walnut Rod
wand_runebound.desc: Polished walnut banded in brass; its pale runes steady the aim.

wand_silverthorn.name: Silverthorn Rod
wand_silverthorn.desc: Black ebony crowned with silver thorns around an emerald crystal.

wand_emberwing.name: Emberwing Rod
wand_emberwing.desc: Crimson lacquer under a gold crown of flame; its crystal burns like a live ember.

wand_moonveil.name: Moonveil Sceptre
wand_moonveil.desc: Moonwood threaded with starlight, a silver crescent holding a star crystal.

robe_apprentice.name: Recruit Robe
robe_apprentice.desc: Sturdy woollen robes issued to every new recruit of the Vigil.

robe_wardens_battle_cloak.name: Warden's Battle Cloak
robe_wardens_battle_cloak.desc: Heavy storm-cured hide, stitched for long watches on the wall.

cloak_wool.name: Woolen Traveller's Cloak
cloak_wool.desc: Undyed homespun wool with a stitched hem and a crude rod patch. Warm, plain and honest.

cloak_runed.name: Runed Mantle
cloak_runed.desc: Navy wool bordered in brass thread, its pale runes humming with a steadying ward.

cloak_thornveil.name: Thornveil Cloak
cloak_thornveil.desc: Black velvet wound with silver thorns and emeralds; curses catch on its vines.

cloak_phoenix.name: Velkar Regalia
cloak_phoenix.desc: Crimson brocade alive with woven flame, a golden firebird spread across the shoulders.

cloak_moonveil.name: Moonveil Mantle
cloak_moonveil.desc: Silver-blue silk scattered with stars and crescent moons; it shimmers like a night sky.

broom_windcutter_2000.name: Reedrunner
broom_windcutter_2000.desc: Lake reed bundled over a bent ashwood frame, with woven mat sails. The patrol's favourite over open water.

broom_skysplitter.name: Stormkeel
broom_skysplitter.desc: Storm-seasoned oak plated in shard-iron, with a ram at the bow. It hums in a crosswind and never slows for it.

broom_ashwood.name: Ashwood Skiff
broom_ashwood.desc: A patrol-issue skiff of unvarnished ash with a patched canvas vane on either side. Every rider starts somewhere.

broom_runebound.name: Brassbound Walnut
broom_runebound.desc: A polished walnut hull bound in brass, its deep blue sails trimmed to steady the flight.

broom_silverthorn.name: Silverthorn Cutter
broom_silverthorn.desc: Black-lacquered ebony with silver fittings and a bladed prow, cut narrow for speed.

broom_emberwing.name: Emberwing Galley
broom_emberwing.desc: Crimson lacquer and gold fittings under two fan sails that smoulder like live embers.

broom_moonveil.name: Moonveil Sloop
broom_moonveil.desc: Pale moonwood threaded with starlight, a crystal at the prow and sails spun from moonlight itself.

potion_mana.name: Mana Draught
potion_mana.desc: Refreshing cerulean elixir. Restores 120 Mana instantly.

mat_phoenix_ash.name: Forge Cinder
mat_phoenix_ash.desc: Cinders raked from a forge that has never gone cold. Used to refine rods from +0 to +4 at Kestrin.

mat_dragon_heartstring.name: Deepvein Ore
mat_dragon_heartstring.desc: Dark ore cut from the veins under the Stone Circle. Needed to refine rods to +5 - +7.

mat_night_steed_hair.name: Starfall Filings
mat_night_steed_hair.desc: Bright filings from a fallen shard, too sharp to hold bare-handed. Required for legendary +8 and +9 rod work.

scroll_imbue.name: Rune of Imbuing
scroll_imbue.desc: A scroll that weaves one new enchantment into a rod, robe or skiff at Kestrin's. The more an item already holds, the likelier the weave slips.

scroll_reweave.name: Rune of Reweaving
scroll_reweave.desc: Unravels every enchantment on a rod, robe or skiff and weaves the same number anew at Kestrin's.

hat_runebound.name: Runebound Hat
hat_runebound.desc: Navy felt banded in brass, pale runes stitched round the brim to steady the mind.

hat_silverthorn.name: Silverthorn Hat
hat_silverthorn.desc: Black velvet wound with a silver thorn circlet, an emerald at its brow.

hat_emberwing.name: Emberwing Hat
hat_emberwing.desc: Crimson brocade crowned with golden feathers, its tip smouldering like an ember.

hat_moonveil.name: Moonveil Hat
hat_moonveil.desc: Silver-blue silk scattered with stars, a silver crescent at its peak.

gloves_runebound.name: Runebound Gloves
gloves_runebound.desc: Walnut-brown leather with brass-capped knuckles; faint runes warm the palms.

gloves_silverthorn.name: Silverthorn Gloves
gloves_silverthorn.desc: Ebony leather gauntlets laced with silver thorn vines and small emeralds.

gloves_emberwing.name: Emberwing Gloves
gloves_emberwing.desc: Crimson salamander hide edged in gold filigree; the fingertips glow like coals.

gloves_moonveil.name: Moonveil Gloves
gloves_moonveil.desc: Moonlit silk gloves threaded with starlight and silver crescents.

boots_runebound.name: Runebound Boots
boots_runebound.desc: Oiled walnut leather laced with brass eyelets, runes worked into the soles.

boots_silverthorn.name: Silverthorn Boots
boots_silverthorn.desc: Tall black boots bound in silver thorns; curses catch on the briars.

boots_emberwing.name: Emberwing Boots
boots_emberwing.desc: Lacquered crimson boots with golden firebird wings at the heel.

boots_moonveil.name: Moonveil Boots
boots_moonveil.desc: Silver-blue boots that leave no print; stars drift in their weave.

focus_runebound.name: Runebound Focus
focus_runebound.desc: A brass-caged rune stone that hums softly when a spell is gathered.

focus_silverthorn.name: Silverthorn Focus
focus_silverthorn.desc: An emerald orb held in a cage of silver thorns, cold to the touch.

focus_emberwing.name: Emberwing Focus
focus_emberwing.desc: A glowing amber heart cradled in golden firebird feathers, warm as a hearth.

focus_moonveil.name: Moonveil Focus
focus_moonveil.desc: A star crystal suspended inside a silver crescent, shining like the night sky.

pendant_runebound.name: Runebound Pendant
pendant_runebound.desc: A brass disc inscribed with a ring of warding runes, worn on a leather cord.

pendant_silverthorn.name: Silverthorn Pendant
pendant_silverthorn.desc: A silver thorn wreath around a polished emerald, sharp at every edge.

pendant_emberwing.name: Emberwing Pendant
pendant_emberwing.desc: A golden firebird spreading its wings around a burning amber stone.

pendant_moonveil.name: Moonveil Pendant
pendant_moonveil.desc: A silver crescent moon cradling a radiant star crystal.

ring_runebound.name: Runebound Ring
ring_runebound.desc: A brass band etched with pale runes that glow faintly at the wearer's will.

ring_silverthorn.name: Silverthorn Ring
ring_silverthorn.desc: Twin silver thorn vines coiled around a deep green emerald.

ring_emberwing.name: Emberwing Ring
ring_emberwing.desc: A gold band shaped like a firebird, an ember-bright amber in its beak.

ring_moonveil.name: Moonveil Ring
ring_moonveil.desc: A silver band set with a star crystal that shimmers like moonlight.

mat_spider_silk.name: Weaver Silk
mat_spider_silk.desc: Pearly, rope-strong silk spun in the Blackweb Caverns. Weavers and robe-makers pay well for it.

mat_weaver_venom.name: Weaver Venom
mat_weaver_venom.desc: Green venom drawn from a Venomfang's glands - worth a fortune to the Still Room.

queen_seal.name: Silk Queen's Seal
queen_seal.desc: An obsidian seal wrapped in old silk. It answers the sealed web gate deep in the Egg Caverns, where the brood's queen waits.

hearth_dust.name: Waycoal
hearth_dust.desc: A lump burned in an Emberway hearth carries you to any hearth you have lit. Sold at every Emberway hearth.

waylink_boot.name: Waystake
waylink_boot.desc: An iron stake forged with a travel-knot. Right-click to drive it into the ground and choose where it leads: for ten seconds your party may take hold, then everyone holding on is carried there together.

dungeon_seal.name: Dungeon Seal
dungeon_seal.desc: A wax seal stamped at a dungeon's end for every run. Spend seals at any dungeon gate on keys, runes and potions.

key_trial.name: Trial Hall Key
key_trial.desc: An iron key to the Trial Hall. The party leader spends keys at the gate to open its Very Hard (1 key) and Legendary (3 keys) runs. Found in Hard runs, sold for seals.

key_sealed_wing.name: Brine Vault Key
key_sealed_wing.desc: A brass key cut for the flood door of the Brine Vaults. The party leader spends keys at the gate to open its Very Hard (1 key) and Legendary (3 keys) runs. Found in Hard runs, sold for seals.
